title: Build a gaming PC under a budget
description: Test the agent's ability to navigate compatibility constraints and price filtering to assemble a working PC build.
query: I want to build a gaming PC for around $1500. Can you suggest compatible components?

title: Best GPU for 1440p gaming
description: Test the agent's ability to filter GPUs by performance tier and compare specifications.
query: Which GPU in stock would be best for 1440p gaming, and what's the price difference between my options?

title: Find compatible motherboard for a CPU
description: Test graph traversal through shared socket nodes to find compatible components.
query: I have an AMD Ryzen 7 7800X3D. Which motherboards are compatible, and what RAM would work with each one?

title: Will a GPU fit in a specific case
description: Test the agent's ability to check physical compatibility constraints between a GPU and case.
query: Will the NVIDIA RTX 4070 Ti Super fit in the Fractal Design North case?

title: PSU recommendation for a CPU and GPU combination
description: Test the agent's ability to calculate combined TDP and recommend an adequately sized PSU.
query: What size PSU do I need for a Ryzen 7 7800X3D and an RTX 4070 Ti Super?

title: Gift recommendation under a price point
description: Test gift suitability filtering combined with price constraints.
query: I need a gift for a tech-savvy teenager, budget is $50. What do you recommend?

title: Camping trip essentials list
description: Test the agent's ability to use activity templates and category requirements to assemble a kit.
query: I'm planning a camping trip. What gear do you have and what would you recommend as essentials?

title: CPU-GPU bottleneck analysis
description: Test the agent's ability to use performance scores to identify potential bottlenecks.
query: Would pairing an Intel Core i5-13600K with an RTX 4070 Ti Super cause any bottleneck issues?

title: Products currently on sale
description: Test the agent's ability to find discounted products by comparing current and original prices.
query: Are there any products on sale right now? I'm looking for deals.

title: Upgrade recommendations for an existing PC
description: Test the agent's ability to reason about upgrade constraints and compatibility with existing components.
query: I have a PC with an Intel 12th gen CPU on an LGA 1700 motherboard with DDR4 RAM. What upgrades would give me the biggest performance boost?
